plugin_desc: RuggedCOM（西门子）工业以太网交换机 SNMP 采集模板（RUGGEDCOM-SYS-INFO-MIB，企业号 15004）。识别门控为 sysObjectID 前缀 1.3.6.1.4.1.15004（ROS RS/RX/MX 族）。采集标量：CPU 使用率（rcDeviceStsCpuUsagePercent，0–100%）、内存空闲（rcDeviceStsAvailableRam，字节）与总量（rcDeviceInfoTotalRam，字节；已用=总量−空闲，利用率=已用/总量×100）、机箱温度（rcDeviceStsTemperature，℃）、冗余电源（rcDeviceStsPowerSupply1/2，RcHardwareStatus：functional(2)→1、notFunctional(3)→2，跳过 notPresent(1)）与风扇组（rcDeviceStsFanBank1/2，RcFanStatus：on(5)/standby(3)→1、failed(2)→2，跳过 notPresent(1)）。接口流量走内置 IF-MIB。不把 tenths CPU 叶当百分数，不把 AvailableRam 当已用，不把温度叶当内存。
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the RuggedCOM industrial switch (RUGGEDCOM-SYS-INFO-MIB rcDeviceStsCpuUsagePercent) as a 0-100 percentage measured over the last second. Do not treat the tenths-of-percent sibling leaf as this value.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total RAM of the RuggedCOM industrial switch in bytes (RUGGEDCOM-SYS-INFO-MIB rcDeviceInfoTotalRam).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Available/free RAM of the RuggedCOM industrial switch in bytes (RUGGEDCOM-SYS-INFO-MIB rcDeviceStsAvailableRam). This leaf is free memory, not used memory.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used RAM of the RuggedCOM industrial switch in bytes, derived as rcDeviceInfoTotalRam minus rcDeviceStsAvailableRam.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the RuggedCOM industrial switch, derived as (total-available)/total*100 from rcDeviceInfoTotalRam and rcDeviceStsAvailableRam.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis temperature of the RuggedCOM industrial switch in degrees Celsius (RUGGEDCOM-SYS-INFO-MIB rcDeviceStsTemperature).

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Power-supply state of the RuggedCOM industrial switch (rcDeviceStsPowerSupply1/2). RcHardwareStatus functional(2) is normalized to 1=normal, notFunctional(3) to 2=abnormal; notPresent(1) is skipped. The reported value is the worst present module.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Fan-bank state of the RuggedCOM industrial switch (rcDeviceStsFanBank1/2). RcFanStatus on(5)/standby(3) is normalized to 1=normal, failed(2) to 2=abnormal; notPresent(1) is skipped. The reported value is the worst present bank.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
